fix1 <- bankdata

# get the index of every row with a value of -1 [True, Fale, False, True] etc
Indices <- (fix1$pdays == -1)
countNoContact <- sum (indices)
percent <- (100* countNoContact)/nrow(bankdata) # calculate the % which are -1
# its a lot
print(paste("Percent Nas: " , round(percent), ""))
# replace them with an NA value
# set the value of pdays to NA on each row that had a value of -1
fix1$pdays[indices] <- NA
# re-calculate but not using NAs
# exclude Nas when calculating the mean
avgPdays <- mean(fix1$pdays, na.rm = T)

print(paste("Avg Pdays", round(avgPdays),  ""))

```{r}
# get trimmed mean()
raw_mean <- mean(bankdata$balance)
raw_median <- median(bankdata$balance)
raw_mean 
raw_median

mean_med_diff = raw_mean - raw_median
mean_med_diff

tenth.percentile <- quantile(bankdata$balance, 0.1)
ninetieth.percentile <-quantile(bankdata$balance, 0.9)

print(paste0("The 10th percentile is ", tenth.percentile))
print(paste0("The 90th percentile is ", ninetieth.percentile))

trimmed <- bankdata[bankdata$balance > tenth.percentile & bankdata$balance < ninetieth.percentile, ]
trimmed.mean <- round(mean(trimmed$balance), 2)
print(paste0("The trimmed mean is ", trimmed.mean))

raw.difference <- abs(raw_median - raw_mean)
trimmed.difference <- abs(raw_median - trimmed.mean)

print(paste("Raw difference is ", raw.difference))
print(paste(" Trimmed difference is ", trimmed.difference))


```

```{r}

# 10 random integers between 1 and 100
random_integers <- sample(1:100, 10)
random_integers

randata_mean <- mean(random_integers)
randata_median <- median(random_integers)
print(paste("mean is", randata_mean))
print(paste("median is", randata_median)) 

iqr <- IQR(random_integers)
print(paste("iqr is", iqr)) 

range <- max(random_integers) - min(random_integers)
print(paste("range is ", range))
```
